implementation.targetScope: The Resvg(svg, {fitTo}).render().asPng() caller in VentiMath functions/src/writeupPicture.ts. Shared repository-owned scan conversion, path geometry and PNG encoder extracted from VLX; no upstream renderer code or native binary copied.
implementation.portableKernel: src/scan.c is independently written scan conversion and lossless PNG filtering, compiled to scan.wasm with checksum-pinned wasi-sdk 34 clang/lld. No libc, WASI imports, native addon or upstream renderer code. Runtime imports only bounded host WebAssembly memory. Rebuild with scripts/build-resvg-wasm.cjs.

differences: Only the generated handwriting SVG vocabulary is public: svg, g, rect and absolute M/L/H/V/Q/C/Z paths, opaque colors and round/butt strokes. Unsupported visual semantics throw.
No CSS, fonts, filters, remote resources, crop, asynchronous worker or general SVG DOM API.
Antialiasing and PNG bytes differ; dimensions and ink placement are compared against upstream.
Public output exposes width, height and asPng; other upstream inspection APIs are outside the used scope.
The internal raster/paths/png exports are shared VLX implementation interfaces, not general SVG contracts.
App adoption requires a separate URL repin; source completion is not deployment.

verification.pixelControls: 66 synthetic paper/pen cases on Node/Bun; 18 additional synthetic pages through unchanged private app layout/caller, with no student data exported.
verification.geometryBounds: Two-million flattened points per live path; every path instance, cached or invisible, is charged to the cumulative 300-million work budget. Exact pixels checked on 26000-character and 8192-item VLX pages; huge paths and excessive total work still reject.
verification.portableKernel: Exact RGBA equality against the JavaScript reference for randomized/coincident/clipped curves and transparency, plus the 1800-drawing VLX corpus and large-page hashes. Node/Bun source and release-archive tests. Original geometry/work/pixel limits retained.
verification.handwritingFollowup: 0.3.6 retains exact sample positions, Float32 accumulation, stable ties and cumulative work charges while merging preordered vertex boundaries. Unique pen paths bypass font caches; retained font keys own storage. Exact 0.3.5 RGBA controls and sequential multi-page memory checks cover the used callers.
